resources.string: The Word travels hand to hand.

Sower respects your privacy completely. It collects no personal information, requests no permissions, and makes no network connections, so it cannot send your data anywhere. Everything you read and search stays only on your device. Nothing is tracked, stored on a server, or shared with anyone.\n\nFreely you received; freely give.
Type a word or phrase, then press search.

This app carries the complete Bible: no internet, no account, no app store. It travels straight from your phone to a friend’s, like a seed passed hand to hand.
Tap Send this app below, then pick any chat app: WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, email, anything that can send a file.
Your friend opens the file they receive and allows the install when their phone asks. That question is normal for an app shared phone to phone.
Done. Their copy can be passed on the same way.

Bluetooth works between any two Android phones with no connection of any kind. Your friend opens their Bluetooth settings screen and stays there, you tap Send this app and choose Bluetooth, then tap their phone name when it appears. If both phones have Quick Share it is quicker still: they swipe down from the top of the screen, press and hold Quick Share, and allow Everyone.
